faq_heading: Homes near Holly Elementary in Delta: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Holly Elementary in Delta catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Holly Elementary in Delta home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Holly Elementary in Delta, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Holly Elementary in Delta?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delta Access (0.8 km west), Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km north-west) and Delta Christian School (1.7 km west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Delta

7 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Holly Elementary in Delta in a straight line (5 elementary, 2 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Delta Access, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Neilson Grove Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Delta Christian School (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ladner Elementary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hawthorne Elementary (1.7 km north-west), Delta Christian School (1.7 km west), Sacred Heart (2.3 km south-west), Ladner Elementary (2.5 km west), Neilson Grove Elementary (2.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hawthorne Elementary, 1.7 km north-west of Holly Elementary in Delta.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Holly Elementary in Delta

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Holly Elementary in Delta can sit in a different catchment.
